rows.text: compares dword `+0x9C` of `rcx` with 2: when equal, tail-jumps through the jump at `003712C0`+0xC with the arguments unchanged; otherwise returns 0
replaces `edx` with dword `+0x38` of `rdx` and tail-jumps `003E6770` with `rcx` unchanged

calls `00426220(rcx, qword +8 of rdx)`; only when that returns 0 does it call `00424010` with the original `rcx` and the floats `+0x2C`, `+0x30` and `+0x34` of `rdx` in `xmm1`, `xmm2` and `xmm3`, otherwise it returns without the second call

notes: 0042BDD0: the entry instruction (the edx load) is half the work; the only interior anchor is the tail jump. 003712C0: the tail-jump target is not named on the page context, so it is cited by its site.
